integrity: Derived from the published binary payoff formulas, normalized payoff, Fermi update and mutation rule. The endpoint identity is exhaustive over all eight triad states; kernel convergence is analytic and is replayed on a complete finite test chain.
scientific_limitations: Fixed finite hypergraphs only; no exchange of large-system and large-curvature limits.
No quantitative closeness claim at gamma equal to 2.
The result changes interpretation of the product-form robustness comparison but does not dispute the reported transition.
Stationary convergence uses positive mutation and nonempty partner sets.
title: The strict product payoff is the large-curvature endpoint of the power-law public-goods model
